column7: -> 2026-09-08_ask-format-action-first.md: Client/Project, problem, options, recommendation; folded into the action-first line that reordered it.
-> 2026-09-02_rotate-in-the-70-80-band-conditionally.md: unprompted self-rotation at a safe boundary; the band (80-90%, not 70%) and the safety conditions are restated there.

When I think Kam is wrong or do not follow his reasoning: say so at the decision point with evidence (or ask), on substance. Either side yields to the better argument; the ruling stays his. A late dictated ruling contradicting an earlier one: check back.

When a deliverable for Kam depends on something pending (ticket number, link, result): say 'hold, waiting on X', then deliver ONCE, complete; no placeholder with a promise to patch. Unless he asks for the partial now; options awaiting his choice are not holes.

When two copies of a seat's tree exist: sync, verify content at the destination, THEN launch (a stale copy writes a fork). .git travels by git, never drive sync. No old-volume absolute paths in tracked files. 'DevMASTER is master' is from 2026-08-25: re-check.

Never run delete verbs (rm, git stash drop, checkout -- over work, rsync --delete): cleanup = move to a dated _quarantine folder, say where. Files in active use are not moved without the owner's word. Carve-outs: scratchpad; own regenerable build leftovers.
-> 2026-11-10_no-wind-down-after-hours-unless-a-break-is-needed.md: agents keep working overnight until the queue is done; folded with the coordinator half into one line.

Before scoring or deploying a change: agent wrap, testing agent (visual and code; real browser if browser-facing), then my completion check against the brief. A wrap triggers QA, not a score. Weight is tiered (none for hygiene). I ratify proof shape, not code.

On a ctx wake: 50% and 70% are checkpoints only (refresh handover, nothing heavy). Rotate unprompted at the first safe boundary in 80-90%: no open agent question or Kam thread, all pushed, agents untouched. Nothing new past 90%. Only a dead seat respawns.

In notes, cards, briefs, handovers and action lists: name the actor (Kam, Wednesday, the Secuura agent) instead of you, I, we or the agent. First person is for live conversation with Kam on the panel; 'you' only in mail to one agent.

When handing Secuura work to Peter or Stuart (review request, text for Kam to send, ticket comment): group into TEST BLOCKS (stream parent, PRs, the one pass that proves it, what the human does), not a flat PR list; a PR fitting no block is stated as such.

Writing or moving a file: name its folder first. Root holds only CLAUDE.md, PORTABILITY.md, .gitignore, Launch_*.command (and a .pre-* backup of one). Screenshots: 0_Brain/reference/<date>_<topic>/; artefacts: 5_Project_History/. Move strays, never delete.

Any ask to Kam names Client/Project (each batched item too). If it needs his hands, lead with 'I need you to do X' as literal pasteable steps, then rationale, my recommendation, options incl. do-nothing. Nothing needed: 'no action needed' first. Keep it short.
-> 2026-09-18_the-boot-spec-outgrew-the-context-window.md: measure files and ctx% before trimming the boot read; its '40 percent, read both whole' figure was overtaken by the 09-18 measurement.

When an instruction arrives on the panel or chat board: post a 1-2 sentence receipt ON the board BEFORE the work, naming it back and who has it (routed ones too). One per instruction, never batched; reports are consolidated. Until Kam says the model settled.
-> 2026-09-09_acknowledge-panel-instructions-on-receipt.md: same Kam ask (2026-09-09 16:07) written up twice; receipt on the board before the work.

At boot: sum the bytes of each mandated whole-read (/4 = tokens); read ctx% before and after the first read. Read WHOLE if it fits; else bound by structure (live head, headline index, newest rows), say what was bounded; never inherit a predecessor's subset.

After hours, while agent-actionable work remains: agents and the coordinator keep working until the queue is done; quiet hours govern speech only. Signature classes and the QA gate still apply. A break is a stated rotation, not an idle seat.
